Why uPVC?

uPVC for a Better Tomorrow

uPVC (Unplasticized Polyvinyl Chloride) is a smart, durable and eco-friendly solution for modern homes and commercial spaces. It offers long-lasting performance with minimal maintenance.

  • Waterproof
  • Termite Proof
  • Budget Friendly
  • Recyclable & Eco-Friendly
  • Fire Retardant

Why Choose uPVC?

The perfect choice for durability, style and sustainability.

Waterproof

Resistant to water and moisture.

Termite Proof

Resistant to termite-related damage and deterioration.

Budget Friendly

A practical and cost-effective solution for interior applications.

Recyclable

uPVC can be recycled and reused through appropriate recycling processes.

Eco-Friendly Choice

Its durability, long service life and recyclability can help reduce frequent material replacement and waste.

Fire-Retardant

uPVC has fire-retardant properties compared with many conventional combustible interior materials.

Frequently Asked Questions

Your Questions, Answered

Do you undertake both construction and interior projects?

Yes. We provide planning, construction and complete interior solutions.

Do you provide a free site visit?

Yes. You can request a free site visit to discuss your project requirements.

Do you provide services across Telangana?

Yes. We undertake projects across Telangana.

Can I choose only interior services?

Yes. You can choose individual interior services or complete project solutions.

Do you provide customized designs?

Yes. Designs are developed according to your space, requirements and preferences.

Which material do you use for interiors?

We primarily use uPVC for our interior works.

How can I get a quotation?

We provide estimates after a site visit and discussion of your project requirements.

Our Process

From Planning to Final Handover

We follow a structured project process to maintain clarity, coordination and quality at every stage.

  1. 01

    Free Site Visit

    Our team visits the project location to understand the site conditions, requirements and expectations.

  2. 02

    Planning & Design

    We prepare practical layouts and design concepts according to the project requirements.

  3. 03

    Quotation

    After reviewing the requirements and finalized scope, we provide a detailed quotation.

  4. 04

    Construction

    Construction work is carried out according to the approved plans and project specifications.

  5. 05

    Interiors

    Customized interior works are executed according to the selected design, materials and requirements.

  6. 06

    Final Inspection

    We review the completed work, finishing and agreed project requirements before handover.

  7. 07

    Handover

    The completed project is handed over after the final review.

About Us

Who We Are

Dream Interiors & Traders

At Dream Interiors & Traders, we turn ideas into well-planned, beautifully finished spaces through thoughtful design and reliable execution. We provide complete solutions across planning, construction and interiors for residential and commercial projects. From the first concept to final handover, our focus is on quality workmanship, clear communication and attention to every detail. We work closely with every client to create spaces that match their requirements, style and vision.

What We Do

End-to-end project solutions.

We provide end-to-end solutions for residential and commercial projects, covering 2D planning, 3D design, construction, renovation and complete interior works.

Our coordinated approach helps clients move smoothly from initial planning and design through execution and final handover.

Our Approach

Practical Planning. Thoughtful Execution.

Every project begins with understanding the client’s requirements, space and expectations.

We focus on practical planning, thoughtful design, suitable material selection and proper execution to create spaces that are functional, durable and visually appealing.

Our Promise

Clear & Transparent Pricing

We provide clearly defined quotations and project scope before execution.

Quality Workmanship

We focus on suitable materials, proper execution and attention to finishing at every stage.

Reliable Project Execution

We follow a structured process and maintain clear communication throughout the project.

On-Time Handover

Our work is planned and coordinated with a focus on completing the project within the agreed timeline.
